title: My Week at School
text:
On Monday, I go to school early. I have English class on Tuesday and Thursday. On Wednesday, I play football with my friends after school. My favorite day is Friday, because I visit my grandmother.

On Saturday, my family goes to the park. We have lunch under a big tree. On Sunday, we stay at home and watch a movie together. I like the weekend because I can rest.

questions.text: What day does the narrator have English class?
Where does the family go on Saturday?
Why is Friday the narrator's favorite day?
options: Because the narrator has no classes at all
Because the narrator gets to see a special person
Because the narrator plays football all day
Because the narrator goes to bed early

questions.text: What can we infer about the narrator's weekdays compared with the weekend?
options: Weekdays are busier, and the weekend is more relaxing
Weekdays are more relaxing, and the weekend is busier
Weekdays and weekends are exactly the same
The narrator has school only on the weekend

vocabulary.definition: the one you like the most
the mother of your mother or father
to relax and stop working or moving

paragraph_translations: Na segunda-feira, eu vou cedo para a escola. Tenho aula de inglês na terça-feira e na quinta-feira. Na quarta-feira, jogo futebol com meus amigos depois da escola. Meu dia favorito é a sexta-feira, porque visito minha avó.
No sábado, minha família vai ao parque. Almoçamos debaixo de uma árvore grande. No domingo, ficamos em casa e assistimos a um filme juntos. Gosto do fim de semana porque posso descansar.
